convert_tf_checkpoint_to_pytorch: convert a TensorFlow MobileBERT checkpoint to a PyTorch model state dict file
load_tf_weights_in_mobilebert: load TensorFlow checkpoint weights into a PyTorch MobileBertForPreTraining model
build_mobilebert_pytorch_model: build a PyTorch MobileBertForPreTraining model from a MobileBertConfig JSON configuration file
run_tf_to_pytorch_conversion_cli: run the MobileBERT TensorFlow to PyTorch checkpoint conversion script via argparse CLI
transpose_tf_kernel_weights: transpose TensorFlow kernel arrays when loading them into PyTorch MobileBERT weight layers
